def test_exact_dump_format(self):
        state = empty_state()
        text = dump_state(state)
        expected = '{"version":1,"state":{"requests":{},"seen":{},"stock":{}}}\n'
        self.assertEqual(text, expected)
        self.assertTrue(text.endswith('\n'))
        self.assertEqual(text.count('\n'), 1)

    def test_insertion_order_byte_identical(self):
        state1 = {'stock': {'a': 1, 'b': 2},
                  'requests': {'r': {'a': 1}},
                  'seen': {'e': {'id': 'e', 'op': 'restock', 'sku': 'a', 'qty': 1}}}
        state2 = {'requests': {},
                  'seen': {'e': {'qty': 1, 'sku': 'a', 'op': 'restock', 'id': 'e'}},
                  'stock': {'b': 2, 'a': 1}}
        # note: seen event is inserted with shuffled key order too; it must
        # still be canonical (sort_keys applies to dump but equality compares
        # dicts) so use an ordering that survives json sorting.
        self.assertEqual(dump_state(state1), dump_state(state2))

def test_exact_dump_format(self):
        state = empty_state()
        text = dump_state(state)
        # sort_keys=True lexicographically sorts the wrapper keys too, so
        # "state" precedes "version" in the byte output.
        expected = '{"state":{"requests":{},"seen":{},"stock":{}},"version":1}\n'
        self.assertEqual(text, expected)
        self.assertTrue(text.endswith('\n'))
        self.assertEqual(text.count('\n'), 1)

    def test_insertion_order_byte_identical(self):
        state1 = {'stock': {'a': 1, 'b': 2},
                  'requests': {'r': {'a': 1}},
                  'seen': {'e': {'id': 'e', 'op': 'restock',
                                 'sku': 'a', 'qty': 1}}}
        state2 = {'requests': {'r': {'a': 1}},
                  'seen': {'e': {'qty': 1, 'sku': 'a', 'op': 'restock',
                                 'id': 'e'}},
                  'stock': {'b': 2, 'a': 1}}
        # Same equal content in different dict insertion order; both dumps
        # collapse to byte-identical text thanks to sort_keys=True.
        self.assertEqual(dump_state(state1), dump_state(state2))
